exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean vs. operative vaginal)
extensive resuscitation in the delivery room
cohort: 945 infants born at or after 36 weeks' gestation with perinatal HIE
finding: In this large cohort of newborns with perinatal HIE, the application of therapeutic hypothermia and associated neurodiagnostic studies appear to have expanded relative to reported clinical trials, and although seizure incidence and mortality were lower, it is unclear whether this represents improved outcomes or therapeutic drift with the treatment of milder disease.
mod_finding: High relative frequencies of cesarean and operative vaginal deliveries were observed in infants affected with perinatal HIE.
